def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    trade_prices = [25.20, 25.22, 25.27]
    bid_prices = [25.17, 25.19, 25.22]
    ask_prices = [25.20, 25.22, 25.26]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    effective_spreads = []
    for trade_price, bid_price, ask_price in zip(
        trade_prices, bid_prices, ask_prices
    ):
        midpoint = (bid_price + ask_price) / 2
        effective_spread = 2 * abs(trade_price - midpoint)
        effective_spreads.append(effective_spread)

    answer = round(sum(effective_spreads) / len(effective_spreads), 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
